title: PortfolioGroup
description: Strategies sharing one capital policy/account. Prevents account structure from silently changing Capital Routing science.

account_id.description: The PORTFOLIO_MASTER account hosting this group.

capital_policy_id.description: References a CapitalPolicyAdapter (e.g. CapitalRoutingPolicy with sealed A/B + H1 semantics).

allocation_config.description: Opaque-to-infra allocation payload owned by the capital policy adapter.

heat_policy.description: Human-readable heat policy id (e.g. H1-1.00-REJ). Must match capital_policy_id semantics.

ownership_mode.description: R0 recommends SINGLE_RUNTIME_MULTI_ADAPTER (one shared heat ledger, one account snapshot).
